taught_elsewhere.on: the cells outside every tile looked at, at the look it was looked at

reveal.what: every VIIRS detection inside the box from the first to the last MODIS overpass, and every one a look owns (the rows of its own pass, in the window or not); look is the scheduled look the row belongs to (-1: none), revealed whether the round looked at its tile on that look

reference.spending: every reference agent spends its budget on the same looks, spread evenly over the round (backend.env.agents.spend_now); only the tile differs. A person may spend a look whenever they choose.
reference.oracle_note: sees the hidden detections and takes the best tile at each look: a ceiling, not a player
reference.reads_nothing_note: random, the constant tile and the centre tiles read nothing about the fire: what they gain is the framing of the episode, and a player shows skill by what it gains beyond them

reference_cache.keyed_on: the episode's rows, box and window, its terrain, the tiles, the budget, the random seeds, the region's CMR pass files, and every file of backend/env, backend/eval and backend/model, backend/firms/cmr_passes.py and backend/server_next_look.py
